reported.title: RPM line format wrong: lowercase prefix and space after colon
reported.description: printRpm() at lines 45-46 emits "rpm: " followed by the value, so the serial stream never contains a line matching ^RPM:-?[0-9]+$. The measured evidence confirms this: "No serial line matched /^RPM:-?[0-9]+$/ in 8.00 s" across all 21 scenarios, including the nominal ramp where timing and values were otherwise fine. The prefix must be uppercase "RPM:" with no space and no trailing text on that line. No serial line matched /^RPM:-?[0-9]+$/ in 8.00 s; expected one every 1000 ms.

reported.title: Printed rpm cannot be parsed because of the wrong RPM line format
reported.description: The value is printed by printRpm() at lines 45-46 as "rpm: <n>", which does not match the required RPM:(-?[0-9.]+) pattern, so the checker reports "No serial line matched /RPM:(-?[0-9.]+)/ so the printed value could not be compared with A5" in every scenario. Even though readRpm() at lines 20-21 scales correctly (raw * 5000/1023 gives mV = rpm), the value is unreachable to the parser until the line is emitted as "RPM:<n>". No serial line matched /RPM:(-?[0-9.]+)/ so the printed value could not be compared with A5.

truth.description: Prints rpm: with space instead of RPM:

exposing_checks.behaviour: serial lines matching '^RPM:' every 1000 ms (RPM: lines)
serial values for 'RPM:(-?[0-9.]+)' match the stimulus (tolerance 50) (rpm value)

judge_input.spec:
- Tach input on A5 at 1 mV per rpm; over-speed lamp on D9; mute on D3 (pull-up).
- Print `RPM:<n>` with no space after the colon once per second (1000 ms ±120 ms).
- Printed rpm must stay within ±50 of the injected tach value.
- Light D9 when rpm is at or above 2000 while mute is released.
- While D3 is held LOW, keep D9 OFF regardless of rpm.
- Each second also print `spindle min=<n> max=<n>` after the RPM line.
